name: @codegrowers/storybook-jaspr-vite
description: A native Storybook renderer and Vite framework for Jaspr components written in Dart.

scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run --bun storybook dev --config-dir example/storybook --port 6006 --no-open --disable-telemetry
scripts.build:example: bun run build && bun run --bun storybook build --config-dir example/storybook --output-dir storybook-static --disable-telemetry
scripts.format: biome format --write src test tool example/storybook example/stories package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json preset.js
scripts.format:check: biome format src test tool example/storybook example/stories package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json preset.js
scripts.lint: biome lint src test tool example/storybook example/stories
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
